notes.title: v0.1.4.5 Update – More Zombies, Deadly Traps, and Action at Its Peak!
notes.content:
🧩 1899: Secrets of the Maze – v0.1.4.5 Update is Live!

🎯 Highlights:

🧟‍♂️ Zombie Count Increased
The maze is now far more dangerous! Expect higher zombie density — stay alert.

🪓 Melee Weapons Enhanced
– Axe and knife damage increased.
– The axe can now kill certain enemies with a single hit!
– Bonus: Axe, knife, and lighter now emit light in darkness!

🔫 Pistol Updated with Auto-Reload Feature
Enjoy a smoother combat experience with automatic reloading.

🔴 Laser Traps Introduced
Sudden laser beams now test your reflexes. Watch your step at all times!

🎵 Music Control Added
You can now completely mute background music via the Music Volume setting.

🔥 Action System Finalized
Melee combat, gunfights, traps, and survival in darkness are now fully implemented.
[hr][/hr]
🛠️ Fixes & Improvements:

🔫 Weapon Damage Boosted
Defeat enemies much more efficiently!

🕯️ Explore with the Lantern
Illuminate your path and uncover the maze’s secrets using the lantern item.

🎒 Inventory System Rebalanced
– Pistol Ammo: 3 boxes (33 bullets each)
– Flashlight Battery: Max 6 units
– Lantern Ammo: Max 3 units
– Medical Kit: 1 unit
– Healing Elixir: Max 33 units

💾 Autosave System Implemented
The game now auto-saves when reaching specific coordinates. Your progress is protected from sudden deaths.

🌐 Asian Font Fixes
Font issues resolved for Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, and Korean.
Note: Minor font glitches may still appear in some UI elements (like Q/Inspect and E/Use keys), but all story notes display perfectly across languages. Tested in both Editor and Steam builds.

🛠️ Steam DRM Launch Issue Resolved
Startup problems caused by Steam DRM have been fixed. The game should now launch reliably.

🚪 Quit Button Issue Fixed
A bug that prevented proper exiting via the Quit button has been addressed. Exits now work as expected.
[hr][/hr]

notes.title: 🛠️ Upcoming Update v0.1.4.3 + Font Issues & Lantern Tips
notes.content:
Hello Maze Runners,

🎯 A new update is coming soon for 1899: Secrets of the Maze: v0.1.4.3

🔹 What’s coming in this version:

Localization improvements (Korean, Japanese, Chinese)

⚠️ Font Display Issues:
We’re currently aware of missing character issues (square boxes) in Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, and Japanese.
The issue doesn’t appear in-editor but happens in the game build. I’m investigating it and hope to fix it soon.

🎥 New Video – “The Power of the Lantern”
I’ve published a video showing how important the Lantern is.
Watch The Power of the Lantern and discover the deeper meaning of light in the maze.

🕯️ Short Gameplay Tips:
Every object in the game has a story.
Try alternate paths and creative solutions to escape the maze and enjoy the mystery.
If you want to finish quickly, check Note 19 and Note 20 for essential info about the Lantern.

💡 About Difficulty:
The game is intentionally designed to be quite easy.
If you encounter something hard, there’s likely a hidden solution to balance the challenge.
Please explore and experiment — there’s always a way out!

Thanks for your support — and don’t get lost in the dark!
